issue: Repair finish(job: dict, worker_id: str, lease_epoch: int, result_digest: str, now: int) -> dict in job_receipt.py. This is an isolated synthetic receipt state machine, not a live queue. Return a deep copy of the input job on success and never mutate the input, including nested metadata. Reject by raising ValueError whose exact message is the code specified below. All documented fields exist and have valid types: status and worker_id are strings; lease_epoch, lease_until, expires_at and now are integers; result_digest is an opaque nonempty string on completed jobs and None otherwise; committed_worker_id, committed_lease_epoch and finished_at are populated on completed jobs and None otherwise. Caller arguments have valid types. No additional type, digest-format or clock validation is required. Preserve every existing field, including unknown nested fields, except the five fields explicitly updated on a first completion. Apply this precedence exactly: (1) If status is done, the immutable stored tuple (committed_worker_id, committed_lease_epoch, result_digest) is authoritative. A caller worker or epoch mismatch raises STALE_LEASE before checking the digest; a matching worker and epoch with a different digest raises RESULT_CONFLICT. An exact tuple replay returns an unchanged deep copy, retaining the original finished_at, even if now is at or past either deadline or current worker_id/lease_epoch fields have changed. A replay does not create a new completion or renew a lease. (2) status cancelled raises CANCELLED; status expired raises EXPIRED. These terminal states take precedence over caller identity and deadlines. (3) Any other status except running raises INVALID_STATUS. (4) For running, mismatch with current worker_id or lease_epoch raises STALE_LEASE before deadlines. (5) now >= expires_at raises EXPIRED, taking precedence if both deadlines have elapsed. (6) now >= lease_until raises LEASE_EXPIRED. (7) Otherwise complete successfully: set status to done, result_digest to the caller digest, committed_worker_id to the caller worker, committed_lease_epoch to the caller epoch, and finished_at to now. Do not change assignment fields, deadlines, job_id or metadata. Use Python standard library only and preserve the finish API.
